Plot the roadmap

Source: R/plot.R
plot_roadmap.Rd

Draws one lane per track with a point wherever a level is reached (hollow = planned, filled = achieved), dependency arrows with their lag (the longest dependency is the dark arrow), quarterly ticks on the time axis and a dashed line for today. Hovering a point shows its date, dependencies and comment (which may span several lines).

plot_roadmap(milestones, editable = FALSE, title = NULL)

Arguments

milestones

A data frame as returned by read_milestones() or resolve_milestones(). Dates are resolved automatically if needed.

editable

If TRUE, points can be dragged sideways and each drop is sent to 'shiny' as input$dragged. Only useful inside the app, see run_roadmap().

title

Optional plot title.

Value

A plotly htmlwidget.

See also

export_snapshot(), run_roadmap()

Examples

plot_roadmap(read_milestones(roadmap_example()))
